top_signals.title: Asian crypto exchanges batten down the hatches as hacks surge: Asia Express
top_signals.summary: Asian crypto exchanges are scrambling to tighten security on fears of a wave of potentially AI-assisted hacks, even as regional governments embrace tokenization and stablecoins.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: ‘The blood is in the streets’: Nasdaq plunges as US midterms rattle SpaceX and Nvidia
top_signals.summary: The Nasdaq index was plunging into the red on Thursday after the US midterms rattled AI-related stocks including Nvidia, Oracle and SpaceX. The tech-heavy index, which tracks 100 of the largest non-financial companies, sank more than five per cent to around 24,416 points.  Chipmakers Nvidia and Broadcom each helped lead losses down eight and nine [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
